persona: Mid-level SAP EWM consultant from an SAP partner
resumeText:
Rohit Kulkarni | Pune | rohit.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
SAP EWM Consultant, Sahyadri SAP Services, Pune (2020 - present)
- Configured embedded EWM on S/4HANA for two distribution warehouses, including storage types, bins and warehouse process types.
- Designed putaway and picking strategies and wave templates for outbound deliveries in a consumer goods warehouse.
- Built RF framework screens for receiving, picking and loading and trained 60 warehouse users.
- Ran fit-gap workshops with warehouse managers and wrote the EWM solution design document.
- Mapped as-is and to-be inbound and outbound flows for the cutover plan.
- Fixed queue errors on the qRFC link between EWM and the ERP during hypercare.
- Wrote integration test scripts and led UAT with the client warehouse team.

SAP MM Associate Consultant, Konkan Tech Solutions, Mumbai (2018 - 2020)
- Supported MM inventory management and goods movements for a cement plant.

SKILLS
SAP EWM, SAP MM, SAP SD, RF framework, Excel

EDUCATION
BE Mechanical Engineering, Pune University, 2018
